description: Intramolecular charge transfer, twisted intramolecular charge transfer, or related excited-state charge-transfer states control emission, quenching, or environment-sensitive AIE/AIEE behavior.
positive_evidence: polarity/viscosity controls separating TICT from RIM
lifetime or transient evidence for CT state
insufficient_evidence: only color change without mechanism evidence
series-level CT claim not tied to target molecule

triage_policy.high: Primary paper with molecule labels and direct ICT/TICT evidence from solvent, computation, lifetime, or geometry controls.
triage_policy.medium: Likely primary AIE/photophysics paper with donor-acceptor CT cues but incomplete mechanism evidence in snippets.
triage_policy.low: Sparse CT wording or application-heavy paper.
triage_policy.reject: Review, patent, database, or no molecule-level CT evidence.
